1879059869.name: Fight On
1879059869.desc: Heals the Champion for a percentage of their health over time.

1879097885.name: No You Don't
1879097885.desc: Seeing a ranged opponent preparing an assault, you take careful aim and disrupt their attempts.

1879134365.name: Shield and Spear
1879134365.desc: Mastery over the Shield: Allows Warden to perform Shield Gambits quickly.

1879157277.name: Bannerguard
1879157277.desc: Call upon your Soldier to assist you in battle, who has trained as a Bannerguard.\n<rgb=#FF0000>Can only be used inside of a Skirmish, while out of combat.</rgb>

1879205789.name: Springtime Horse
1879205789.desc: A horse from the Springtime Festival.

1879209885.name: Steed of the Warden
1879209885.desc: A mount carrying all the trappings that are used and needed by the warden.

1879231389.name: Ranged Warden's Triumph
1879231389.desc: A triumphant blow, allowing the Warden to deal even more damage.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879241629.name: Cry of the Eorlingas
1879241629.desc: Crying for the wrath of Rohan, you unleash terrible ruin upon your foe.

1879255453.name: Stagger
1879255453.desc: An attack that impairs the target, removing a corruption and reducing their combat readiness if you are flanking them.

1879261981.name: Cry Vengeance
1879261981.desc: When an enemy is defeated, you let out a Cry that increases attack speed for you and your allies.

1879266845.name: Quick Shot
1879266845.desc: The Dúnedain are skilled at quickly loosing arrows at their foes.

1879311261.name: Shake Free
1879311261.desc: Allows you to break free of effects that cause you to lose control of your actions.

1879326493.name: Umber Goat
1879326493.desc: Summons a goat to keep you company.

1879342109.name: Guide to Haerondir
1879342109.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Haerondir.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879354909.name: Return to the Udûn Foothold
1879354909.desc: Thanks to your friendship with the Conquest of Gorgoroth, you're able to quickly return to the Udûn Foothold. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879365405.name: Thrush
1879365405.desc: Brings out a thrush to keep you company.

1879411741.name: Buff Donkey
1879411741.desc: Summons a loveable and hard-working donkey.

1879416221.name: Two-toned Sheep
1879416221.desc: Summons a sheep to keep you company.

1879427869.name: Jump Cut
1879427869.desc: Glúrkub's most damaging strike requires him to leave his feet, but he does so gracefully and without warning.

1879452573.name: Rush!
1879452573.desc: Even in the midst of battle, you're able to push your body to move faster for a brief period.

1879457565.name: Desperate Spear
1879457565.desc: Channel your desperation into a blur of impossibly fast strikes, dealing significant damage to enemies in front of you.

1879466269.name: Advance
1879466269.desc:
Advance on your opponent with two thrusts.

<rgb=#FF7700>Swordplay:
 Finishers deal increased damage.</rgb>
<rgb=#ecdd11> Debilitating Strike disarms your target.</rgb>
<rgb=#33BCFF>Dramatic Flourish gives even greater chance to critically hit.</rgb>

1879467293.name: Rummage
1879467293.desc: You never know what forgotten treasures have been left at the bottom of your pockets.\n\nRummaging in your pocket may turn up different objects.

1879467805.name: To Your Aid
1879467805.desc: You call on nature to aid an ally and increase the Morale of your target.

1879488029.name: Friend of Noble Birds (Frosted Forest Owl)
1879488029.desc: Summons an eagle-type companion.\n\nThis is a noble creature which can deal damage and, if called upon, will sacrifice itself to save you.

1879502365.name: Unsettling Skull
1879502365.desc: Examine an unsettling skull recovered from Utug-bûr.

1879506589.name: Acid Breath
1879506589.desc: Using fell knowledge and potions, send forth searing acid in a cone in front of you.<rgb=#00ffff>\n\nCan be prepared as a Sorcerous Study.</rgb>

1879508253.name: Double Down
1879508253.desc: Double down on your current target, increasing the tier of a current damaging gamble and rolling damaging gambles on surrounding enemies.

1879508637.name: Striped Grodbog Protector
1879508637.desc: Summons a striped grodbog protector to accompany you on your travels.

1879510045.name: Melee Blindside
1879510045.desc: Interrupt an enemy's actions with a single melee strike and follow it with a single bow-attack at close range.

1879517981.name: Conviction
1879517981.desc: Call upon the eagle's conviction to restore the Morale of your fellows.

1879522077.name: A Memento of Idagâl
1879522077.desc: Place down a memento you found in Idagâl. You may want to block your ears.

1879532573.name: Hidden Treasure
1879532573.desc: Defeating a foe has a 1% chance to reveal a hidden reward. Ends when it triggers.
